findings.title: Only apps/web is linted; four workspaces have no lint script
evidence: apps/web/package.json has lint; apps/realtime, packages/contracts, packages/game-core, packages/config do not
root package.json lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
915 tests pass but realtime/game-core have no lint gate
findings.impact: Lint regressions in the authoritative server and game core are not caught; the root `lint` claim is weaker than it appears.
findings.recommendation: Add eslint config + lint scripts to the remaining workspaces and make `npm run lint` cover all of them.

findings.title: Large generated evidence artifacts inflate the repository
findings.impact: Clone cost and diff noise grow with every audit/evidence cycle.
findings.recommendation: Archive large generated exports outside git (LFS/object store) and keep only manifests/hashes in-tree.
findings.note: Evidence is append-only by doctrine; recorded as owner-accepted.

report: Hygiene: monorepo with workspaces, prettier, eslint, .gitattributes LF policy, .gitleaks.toml, LICENSE and CONTRIBUTING. Residual: only apps/web has a lint script; the other four workspaces are unlinted. Multi-MB generated evidence exports remain tracked (see INV-P2-001).
